servicesSub: Not sure which visa fits? Call (02) 8628 7336.

services.title: Student visas
services.long: Student visas let students from other countries join a full-time college or university in Australia. IMC also helps with the Professional Year and student health cover (OSHC).

services.title: Skilled migration
services.long: Skilled migration visas for people with qualifications and experience in professions and trades.

services.title: Employer sponsored
services.long: Australian employers can sponsor overseas workers on temporary and permanent visas. IMC works with local employers too.

services.title: Partner & family
services.long: Partner visas for married and de facto partners of Australians, and family visas to join children or other qualifying family members.

services.title: Business & investment
services.long: Business Innovation and Investment visas for successful business people and investors who want to settle in Australia.

services.title: Visitor visas & citizenship
services.long: Travel and tourist visas, Australian citizenship applications and tribunal review applications.

aboutParas: International Migration Centre (IMC) was founded in 2005 and is an Australian owned and operated business, upstairs at 57-59 Dunmore Street, Wentworthville.
IMC has helped thousands of overseas individuals, families and local corporate clients with their migration matters, including 1,225 student visas, 556 family visas and 450 travel visas.
Clients are kept up to date at every stage, and IMC can arrange an interpreter for your language if you need one.
